test_cases.test_case: Login with valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: User authenticated and redirected to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with empty Username field
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Username is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with empty Password field
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Password is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with invalid credentials
steps: 1. Enter <invalid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to login with locked out user
steps: 2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner shows 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long username
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error shown indicating the username is too long or the form submits successfully with the username truncated.

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Error shown indicating invalid characters in the Username field.

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the Username field
steps: 1. Enter '   standard_user   ' in the Username field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; user is authenticated and redirected to the Product Inventory page.

test_cases.test_case: Enter zero as Username
test_cases.expected_result: Error shown: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' button for a product
test_cases.expected_result: Item added to cart; button changes to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Item removed from cart; button changes to 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: View product detail
steps: 1. Click on a product name or image
test_cases.expected_result: Product detail page opens

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add a product to cart without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click 'Add to cart' on any product
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove a product from cart without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view product detail without being logged in
steps: 1. Navigate to the Product Inventory page
2. Click on a product name or image
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long product name
steps: 1. Locate the product name input field
2. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the product name field
test_cases.expected_result: Product name input is accepted or truncated with a visible indicator

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the product description
steps: 1. Locate the product description input field
2. Enter special characters and emojis in the product description field
test_cases.expected_result: Product description input is accepted or a specific error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the product name
steps: 1. Locate the product name input field
2. Enter '   Product Name   ' in the product name field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved product name shows 'Product Name'

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product added to cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Product removed from cart; success message shown

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to shopping cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add product to cart without being logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; no product is added to cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove product from cart without being logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; no product is removed from cart

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate back to products without being logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; no navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate to shopping cart without being logged in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; no navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after adding to cart
preconditions: Product is displayed on the Product Detail page
steps: 2. Immediately click 'Add to cart' button again
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission attempt is blocked; only one product appears in the cart

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after removing from cart
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission attempt is blocked; product remains removed from the cart

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to products after adding to cart
preconditions: Product is displayed on the Product Detail page
Product has been added to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory page without any cart state change

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Shopping Cart after adding to cart
preconditions: Product is displayed on the Product Detail page
Product has been added to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Navigated to Shopping Cart page displaying the added product

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Continue Shopping
test_cases.expected_result: Returned to Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: User clicks Checkout
test_cases.expected_result: Started checkout process

test_cases.test_case: User removes an item from the cart
steps: 1. Click Remove button for an item
test_cases.expected_result: Item removed from cart

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access the Shopping Cart
steps: 1. Attempt to access the Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to checkout
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to remove an item from the cart
steps: 1. Attempt to click Remove button for an item
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Add a very long description to an item
steps: 1. Add an item with a description of more than 200 characters to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to the cart with the long description displayed correctly

test_cases.test_case: Add an item with special characters in the description
steps: 1. Add an item with a description containing special characters (e.g., @#$%^&*()) to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Item is added to the cart with the description displayed correctly

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click Continue Shopping after adding an item
preconditions: Item is added to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Product Inventory without any errors or duplicate actions

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with all required fields filled
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid postal code> in the Zip/Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Proceeds to the overview step

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout process
test_cases.expected_result: Returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with all required fields empty
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field blank
2. Leave the Last Name field blank
3. Leave the Postal Code field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required', 'Error: Last Name is required', and 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing First Name
steps: 1. Leave the First Name field blank
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Enter <valid postal code> in the Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing Last Name
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Leave the Last Name field blank
3. Enter <valid postal code> in the Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Last Name is required'

test_cases.test_case: Submit form with missing Postal Code
steps: 1. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
2. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
3. Leave the Postal Code field blank
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout process
test_cases.expected_result: Returns to the Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in First Name field
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the First Name field
2. Fill Last Name with a valid name
3. Fill Postal Code with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the long First Name

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in Last Name field
steps: 2. Enter special characters in the Last Name field
3. Fill Postal Code with a valid code
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the special characters in Last Name

test_cases.test_case: Enter value with leading/trailing whitespace in Postal Code field
steps: 3. Enter ' 12345 ' in the Postal Code field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: Finish the order
preconditions: Order summary is displayed with cart items and totals
test_cases.expected_result: Order completed; navigates to confirmation page

test_cases.test_case: Cancel the checkout process
preconditions: Order summary is displayed with cart items and totals
test_cases.expected_result: Exited checkout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to finish order without completing payment information
test_cases.expected_result: Order is not completed; user remains on the overview page with an error indicating payment information is required

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to cancel checkout without any prior actions
test_cases.expected_result: User is exited from checkout; no changes to the order are made

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click Finish after viewing the order summary
preconditions: User is on the overview step with an order summary displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Order is completed; navigates to confirmation page without error

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly click Cancel after viewing the order summary
preconditions: User is on the overview step with an order summary displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Exited checkout; no additional confirmation prompts shown

test_cases.test_case: Confirm order and return home
test_cases.expected_result: The page displays 'Thank you for your order!'

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access confirmation page
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirmation page without logging in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to confirm order without items in cart
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirmation page with an empty cart
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page does not display a success message; user remains on the page

test_cases.test_case: User successfully logs out
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page.

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access a protected page
steps: 2. Attempt to access the inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; access to the inventory page is blocked.

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to access another protected page
steps: 2. Attempt to access the checkout page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; access to the checkout page is blocked.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access protected pages after logout
steps: 2. Attempt to access the inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; access to the inventory page is blocked.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access protected pages immediately after logout
steps: 2. Press the back button in the browser
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page; the inventory page is not displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State action
steps: 1. Click on the 'Reset App State' button
test_cases.expected_result: Cart cleared and in-app state reset

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user attempts to reset app state
steps: 1. Attempt to perform the Reset App State action without logging in
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive reset actions
preconditions: User is logged in and has items in the cart
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
2. Immediately click the Reset App State button again
test_cases.expected_result: First reset action clears the cart and resets in-app state; second action is blocked with no additional effect.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to reset state with an empty cart
preconditions: User is logged in and cart is empty
steps: 1. Click the Reset App State button
test_cases.expected_result: Cart remains empty; in-app state reset successfully without errors.
